title: Live catalog source readiness gate
privacyBoundary: External occurrence or distribution coordinates are raw/source-only metadata when a source license allows capture. They are not OverGarden user/product location data and must not enter canonical product projections, analytics, Meilisearch, logs, public pages, or UI without a later explicit ADR and SDD slice.

verdictLegend.USE: Current access and reuse basis are good enough for the named next ingestion slice, subject to attribution and field limits.
verdictLegend.USE-WITH-CONDITIONS: Technically reachable, but canonical product use is blocked until the listed legal, parser, license, or field-filter condition is satisfied.
verdictLegend.INTERNAL-VALIDATION-ONLY: May be used only to cross-check or validate internal decisions. Do not bulk ingest, redistribute, or expose in product projections.
verdictLegend.REJECT: Do not use for ingestion or validation without a new legal basis or explicit maintainer decision.

operatorSummary.nextSliceGate: OVE-56 may create raw/source snapshot quarantine only from USE sources. OVE-57, OVE-58, and OVE-60 may consume the explicitly named USE sources below. OVE-59, OVE-61, OVE-62, and marketplace/vendor paths must not promote conditional or internal-validation-only data until their blockers are closed.

fullImportReadiness.title: Full catalog import readiness gate
fullImportReadiness.operatorDecision: Full catalog import is allowed only as controlled waves: raw/source quarantine first, then dry-run counts and leak checks, then source-family projection slices, then entity-resolution QA, then production proof. This gate does not approve an unsafe all-at-once product projection.

waveLegend.raw_quarantine_allowed: Source rows may be captured into source snapshot/quarantine tables with provenance, checksums, license, and source-only field flags.
waveLegend.product_projection_allowed: Some fields from this source may reach product-facing catalog/typeahead after the named importer, dry-run, attribution, dedupe, and privacy checks pass.
waveLegend.operator_review_required: Rows or aliases need operator/curator review before becoming product-visible, even if raw capture is allowed.
waveLegend.legal_blocked: Legal, reuse, license, database-right, or terms evidence is insufficient for product projection.
waveLegend.parser_blocked: The exact export/parser/row-filter path is not yet strong enough for full-volume automated import.
waveLegend.rejected: No ingestion path is allowed without a new partner/legal basis.
